tools.description: Open URL in visible in-app browser

tools.name: browserReadStructured
tools.description: Get page structure as JSON (title, links, forms, buttons)

tools.name: browserFillForm
tools.description: Fill a form field by label/name/id

tools.name: openInChrome
tools.description: Open URL in Chrome (for logged-in sites)

prompt_section:
### Browser Tools (NO accessibility needed)
- browserOpen(url) — open URL in visible in-app browser
- browserReadStructured() — get page JSON (title, links, forms, buttons, text)
- browserGetLinks() — list all links
- browserGetForms() — list form fields
- browserFillForm(field, value) — fill form by label/id/name
- browserClickElement(selector) — click by CSS selector
- browserClickText(text) — click by visible text
- browserGetText(selector) — get text from element
- browserScreenshot(prompt) — capture page → VLM
- browserScrollDown(pixels?) — scroll down
- openInChrome(url) — open in Chrome (logged-in sites)
- searchInChrome(query) — Google search in Chrome
